# Yurii Myronov

> Lead developer focused on backend architecture and clean, maintainable code. I build reliable systems end to end. My backends are written in Go and Python, with modern frontends on top. Everything runs on infrastructure I host and manage myself. Recently I have been connecting my apps to LLMs through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

- Role: Lead Developer at Dlubal Software (https://www.dlubal.com)
- Location: Prague, Czechia — CET (GMT+1)
- Availability: Open to opportunities
- GitHub: https://github.com/Meizuno
- Website: https://meizuno.github.io

## Stack

- Backend: Python, Go, FastAPI, Django, Gin, Nitro, Node.js
- Frontend: TypeScript, Vue, Nuxt, Tailwind CSS
- API & AI: REST, GraphQL, gRPC, MCP, OpenAI
- Databases: PostgreSQL, Redis, SQLite, MongoDB, Prisma, SQLAlchemy, GORM
- Cloud & DevOps: Docker, Traefik, Nginx, Cloudflare, S3, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD
- Observability: VictoriaLogs, Vector, Uptime Kuma
- Testing: Pytest, Vitest, Ruff, mypy, ESLint, Newman

## Projects

- [Authentication](https://github.com/Meizuno/Authentication) — Auth microservice with JWT + refresh-token rotation and Google OAuth — the single sign-on all my apps delegate to (Go, Gin, JWT)
- [Money Manager](https://github.com/Meizuno/MoneyManager) — Personal finance tracker, integrated with AI Chat over the Model Context Protocol (Nuxt, PostgreSQL)
- [Recipes Book](https://github.com/Meizuno/RecipesBook) — Recipe manager, integrated with AI Chat over the Model Context Protocol (Nuxt, PostgreSQL)
- [Whisper Service](https://github.com/Meizuno/WhisperService) — Self-hosted speech-to-text (faster-whisper) that powers voice input in AI Chat (Python, FastAPI)
- [Library](https://github.com/Meizuno/Library) — A Clean Architecture Example in Python
- [Docket](https://github.com/Meizuno/Docket) — Pull-based task queue built on FastAPI and Postgres
- [Infrastructure](https://github.com/Meizuno/Infrastructure) — Self-hosted stack: Traefik + Cloudflare tunnel, zero-downtime Docker deploys
- [AI Chat](https://github.com/Meizuno/AIChat) — LLM chat hub that drives my apps as MCP tools
- [Notes](https://notes.meizuno.com/) — Self-hosted notes vault with graph and folder views
